sources.title: JMIR Medical Informatics - Improving AI-Based Clinical Decision Support ...
sources.snippet: Background: Artificial intelligence (AI)-based systems are receiving increasing attention in the health care sector. While the use of AI is well advanced in some medical applications, such as image recognition, it is still in its infancy in others, such as clinical decision support systems (CDSS).

sources.snippet: AI-driven clinical decision support systems (CDSS) further assist physicians in improving drug compliance and optimizing population health strategies by identifying pharmacologically cost-effective therapies.
